faults.fault: 'Hertz spread 1.47 mm' does not follow from its own formula: a=(3FR/4E*)^(1/3)=0.27 mm (0.54 mm diameter); 1.47 is the dC value copied

dC 1.47 fF applies the local Hertz strain to the whole 1.5 mm taxel with the skin modulus; with that modulus a 1 mN load on one taxel gives ~0.06 fF; only with the soft pillar modulus (~0.8 fF) would it work, which is not the stated derivation
2x AD7746-class CDC give 4 channels at <100 Hz; ~100 taxels (20x16 mm at 1.5 mm pitch) and 1-2 kHz slip sampling are impossible without an unmentioned multiplexer and faster converter
